task: ROS scan and navigation planning; base and wrist visual target; pick; carry planning; park and place on second table

first_physical_batch.gate: targeted offline nominal and park/vision gating checks
same frozen P controller; prior run fully cleaned up

strategy_scope.G: Frozen W1 full-body predictive moving grasp
strategy_scope.P: Same W1 vision and pick-carry-place task; measured parked base required for insertion; base command equality zero during manipulation; not a reproduction of an external paper
strategy_scope.M: Later versioned reactive one-step whole-body port; no claim of full MotM reproduction; at most two declared parameters and four offline adjustments before physical nominal

shared_conditions.unchanged: same model, velocity and acceleration limits, perception, Shield, contact validity, grasp evidence, lift, slip, placement and stop criteria

comparison_rules.completion: physical stable release on second table, not phase alone
comparison_rules.time: same task start to stable placement; abort time is never a successful completion time
comparison_rules.smoothness: same 0.10 second pose-difference acceleration convention; separate grasp, carry and place windows; report TCP error, near-stop and reversal time alongside acceleration
comparison_rules.safety: forbidden contacts, penetration, geometric margin with explicit model coverage, CBF and Shield intervention, stop effectiveness
comparison_rules.interpretation: designed cases, not independent randomized trials or universal superiority over MotM; do not pool older nonvisual/nonplacement runs
